## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for behaviour changes
- [ ] No new `any` without a comment explaining why
- [ ] Screenshots or a short recording for UI changes
- [ ] **Performance-related changes include before/after benchmark numbers** ([write-up template](https://github.com/Karthik-beta/Blinkql/wiki/Performance-and-Benchmarks#write-up-template))
- [ ] New interactive UI is keyboard-accessible and labelled
- [ ] Docs or wiki updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] An ADR is included if this is hard to reverse (new core dependency, data-flow or storage-format change)
